May 30, 2026The goal of VoxelForge is to demonstrate how a voxel engine works from the ground up using Unity and C#. Instead of creating every block as a separate GameObject, the world is stored as voxel data and rendered through optimized chunk meshes. This makes the project more focused on real engine architecture rather than simple block placement.
